purpose: Hear what the stronger direction changes. Same words, same voice, same pictures, same timing. Only the performance shaping differs.

A.label: SHIPPED — the directed take in the Round 13/14 film

what_changed: Per-word emphasis is now actually rendered (sixty, bell, Vellara, bronze, tower, silent, Nora, stone, four, rang, three). The direction always named these words; the old assembler ignored them.
Wider gain and spectral-tilt contrast between emotional beats, widened about the mean so the read is not globally darker or quieter.
A presence lift applied AFTER compression on the upward beats (reveal/surprise/excitement) — the compressor was previously eating it.
Pauses carry matched room tone instead of digital silence.
note: 0.4 LU quieter than the shipped master because the wider dynamics hit the -2 dBTP ceiling sooner. That is the intended trade, not a defect.
